profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m Full-Stack Software Engineer currently based in Akron, Ohio. I’ve spent the past 12+ years working across many areas, such as back-end development, mobile development (iOS & Android), UI/UX Design and project management. Currently focusing my time doing front-end development (React / Next.js), leading projects and keeping up with new technologies, tools and languages. Besides work, I love spending time with my family, playing video games and composing/mixing/mastering music.

For more details, visit my website at: http://www.prodz.dev
